tagline: We make a number for every game. We bet the ones where the market's wrong.

games.take: The marquee game of the night, and the board's only edge lives here: Daniss Jenkins Under 3.5 Rebounds at -109 is +1.9% EV against devigged FanDuel. Jenkins is under 3.5 in 6 of his last 10, averaging 3.6 rebounds with a 3.4 projection, and the Spurs own the glass with Victor Wembanyama at 11.6 boards a night. San Antonio is 12-2 and has won 12 straight, with De'Aaron Fox back after missing Sunday. Detroit is 8-4 but down five rotation players — Jalen Duren, Duncan Robinson, Ron Holland II, Taurean Prince all out, Isaiah Joe doubtful — and down to a seven-man rotation. Our fair number makes San Antonio a 78.6% favorite, and no side price clears our 0.75% bar. No true edge on the side, but the lean is San Antonio -9.5: the hottest team in the league at home against a skeleton-crew visitor.
games.title: Pistons at Spurs: the board's only edge lives here
games.venue: Frost Bank Center, San Antonio, TX
games.verdict: LEAN: SAS -9.5 — no true edge on the side; the 12-2 Spurs at home against a Pistons side down five rotation players. (Board play: Daniss Jenkins Under 3.5 Rebounds -109, +1.9% EV.)

games.our_fair: Timberwolves 54.0% / Trail Blazers 46.0% (devigged Pinnacle fair, moneyline)
games.take: The rematch, one night later, same floor. Minnesota beat Portland 106-98 on Monday, and both sides are still short-handed: the Wolves are without Anthony Edwards (knee surgery), Donte DiVincenzo and Jaylen Clark, and Jonathan Kuminga is day-to-day after leaving Monday's game with a shoulder issue. Portland is without Shaedon Sharpe (torn meniscus, out months), Ja Morant and Chris Youngblood. Last night's Camara prop — the board's only play — lost, but the side stays fairly priced: our fair number makes Minnesota a 54.0% favorite, and no price clears our 0.75% bar. No true edge, but the lean is Portland +2.5: the Blazers were right there last night, and Minnesota is still missing its best guards.
games.title: Trail Blazers at Timberwolves: the rematch
games.verdict: LEAN: POR +2.5 — no true edge; the road dog that was right there last night, against a Minnesota side still missing its best guards.

games.take: The Knicks arrive in Toronto healthy — no one on the injury report — while the Raptors are without Kawhi Leonard (knee) and Nate Bittle (foot), with Kevin McCullar Jr. day-to-day with an illness. New York is the better roster on paper and our fair number makes the Knicks a 57.0% favorite, but the closest near-miss on the board was the total: Over 214.5 at -105 was +0.6% EV against the devigged Pinnacle fair, just short of our 0.75% bar, so it stays off the board. No true edge, but the lean is New York -3.5: the healthy road favorite against a Raptors side missing its best player.
games.title: Knicks at Raptors: the healthy road favorite
games.verdict: LEAN: NYK -3.5 — no true edge; the healthy road favorite against a Raptors side without Kawhi Leonard.

games.take: Both sides are banged up, but the Clippers are the better team at home. Los Angeles is without Brandon Ingram (Achilles) and Bradley Beal (knee), while Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. — diagnosed with a torn MCL, out 6-to-8 weeks — and Jusuf Nurkic (toe). Our fair number makes the Clippers a 68.7% favorite, and no price clears our 0.75% bar. No true edge, but the lean is the Clippers -6.5: the home favorite against a Jazz side missing its interior anchor.
games.title: Jazz at Clippers: the home favorite by default
games.verdict: LEAN: LAC -6.5 — no true edge; the home favorite against a Jazz side without Jaren Jackson Jr.

games.take: The late game, and the biggest favorite on the NBA slate. The Lakers are without Austin Reaves (heel) and Walker Kessler (leg), and LeBron James is day-to-day with a back issue, but Charlotte is without Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Dennis Schroder (hamstring) too — and the Hornets are the weaker roster even at full strength. Our fair number makes Los Angeles a 73.7% favorite, and no price clears our 0.75% bar. No true edge, but the lean is the Lakers -7.5: the home favorite with the far better top end, LeBron's status as the honest caveat.
games.title: Hornets at Lakers: the late-night favorite
games.verdict: LEAN: LAL -7.5 — no true edge; the home favorite against a short-handed Hornets side, LeBron day-to-day as the caveat.

games.matchup: Eastern Michigan Eagles @ Western Michigan Broncos
games.take: MACtion opens the night in Kalamazoo. Western Michigan brings a two-game winning streak and three straight in this rivalry into a home game against an Eastern Michigan side coming off its bye. The Broncos' defense is the story — the total sits at 46.5, and the market expects a low-scoring night. Weather is a non-factor: clear, 44F at kickoff with a light wind, no watches or warnings. Our fair number makes Western Michigan an 86.1% favorite, and no price clears our 0.75% bar. No true edge, but the lean is Western Michigan -14.5: the hotter, healthier home side in a rivalry it has owned lately.
games.title: Eastern Michigan at Western Michigan: MACtion opens in Kalamazoo
games.verdict: LEAN: WMU -14.5 — no true edge; the home favorite in a rivalry it has won three straight.
games.weather: Clear, 44F at kickoff, light wind; no NWS watch or warning.

games.take: The near-miss of the night. Ohio moneyline at -323 was +3.2% EV against our fair line — but that price sits at Marathonbet, not a US book, and the best US price (ESPN Bet -360) is only +0.7% EV, just short of our 0.75% bar. So it stays off the board, and the lesson is written on it: a price you cannot bet is not an edge. Ohio is 7-3 (5-1 in the MAC) against a 3-7 Ball State side, and the Bobcats are 11.5-point favorites at home in Athens, where the weather is cool and clear. Our fair number makes Ohio a 78.8% favorite. No true edge at a bettable price, but the lean is Ohio -11.5: the far better team at home, with Pinnacle hanging -10.0 as the note that the market may be a touch heavy on the favorite.
games.title: Ball State at Ohio: the edge you cannot bet
games.verdict: LEAN: OHIO -11.5 — no true edge at a bettable price; the 7-3 home favorite, with Pinnacle a point shorter as the caveat.
games.weather: Cool and clear; no NWS watch or warning.

games.matchup: Miami (OH) RedHawks @ Kent State Golden Flashes
games.our_fair: RedHawks 76.9% / Golden Flashes 23.1% (devigged Pinnacle fair, moneyline)
games.take: The nightcap of the MAC tripleheader. Miami (OH) is 6-4 against a 3-7 Kent State side that just got run off the field 38-7 at Western Michigan, and the RedHawks are 9.5-point road favorites at Dix Stadium. Kent's forecast is clear around 42F at kickoff, cooling into the upper 30s — cold, but dry and calm enough that it should not decide anything. Our fair number makes Miami a 76.9% favorite, and no price clears our 0.75% bar. No true edge, but the lean is Miami -9.5: the better team on the road against a Kent side that has been outclassed by the MAC's better teams.
games.title: Miami (OH) at Kent State: the nightcap
games.verdict: LEAN: M-OH -9.5 — no true edge; the better road team against a Kent side that just lost 38-7.
games.weather: Clear around 42F at kickoff, cooling into the upper 30s; no NWS watch or warning.
